text: 律師神情嚴肅走向發言臺
說明這起引發全美高度關注的司法事件

律師團證實

She has a blood clot in one of her arms.
She has pneumonia.
She is not able to swallow yet, so she is not eaten.
She cannot move either of her arms.
Both of her arms and hands are tremendously swollen.
